shared_elements: possibly an amorphous humanoid/limb-like shape (A) versus explicit human figures (B)
justification: A shows only a diffuse reddish blotch on a mottled surface with no legible motif beyond a vaguely limb- or figure-like patch, while B shows a fully articulated scene of a standing figure facing a kneeling/adoring figure across an offering stand, topped and underlaid by ordered registers of sign-writing. Apart from the possibility that A's stain once represented something human, there is no shared element, relationship or compositional scheme, and the manner of depiction (unbounded painted smear vs. precise incised outline with conventional profile anatomy) is entirely different.
